mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (id, file_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, text_length, token_count, metadata) VALUES
(#{c.id}, #{c.fileId}, #{c.chunkIndex}, #{c.content}, CAST(#{c.embedding} AS vector), #{c.textLength}, #{c.tokenCount},
CAST(#{c.metadata} AS jsonb) NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT t.chunkId, t.fileId, f.title AS fileTitle, f.kb_name AS kbName, f.source AS source, t.chunkIndex, t.content, t.tokenCount, t.distance FROM ( SELECT c.id AS chunkId, c.file_id AS fileId, c.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, c.content AS content, c.token_count AS tokenCount, (c.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryVector} AS vector)) AS distance FROM knowledge_chunk c ORDER BY c.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryVector} AS vector) LIMIT #{candidateLimit} ) t JOIN knowledge_file f ON f.id = t.fileId WHERE (#{kbName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR f.kb_name = #{kbName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ORDER BY t.distance ASC LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT c.id FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_file f ON f.id = c.file_id CROSS JOIN unnest(CAST(#{grams} AS text[])) AS g(word) WHERE (#{kbName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR f.kb_name = #{kbName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND c.content ILIKE ('%' || word || '%') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS chunkId, c.file_id AS fileId, f.title AS fileTitle, f.kb_name AS kbName, f.source AS source, c.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, c.content, c.token_count AS tokenCount, NULL::float8 AS distance FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_file f ON f.id = c.file_id WHERE c.id IN #{id}
